input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale: Article XII is a one-way indemnity running only from Licensee to Licensor, and it is exceptionally broad (Licensee's exercise of the licence, the conduct of its business, and any breach of the Agreement). There is no Licensor indemnity anywhere; worse, Article XIII(a) expressly states that Licensor shall not be liable for any claim that use of the Licensed Technology infringes third-party intellectual property rights, and the warranty disclaimer excludes non-infringement. That is walk-away territory under this rule (no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity for the Vendor's technology). We therefore add a Licensor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, Licensor-caused data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics (stated to override Article XIII so the liability exclusion does not gut it), and narrow the Licensee indemnity to Licensee-provided content and Licensee's breach of law. Fallback (IP indemnity with customary exclusions and a 3x annual fee super-cap) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add Licensor IP/misconduct indemnity and narrow Licensee's indemnity
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a Licensor indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims and for Licensor's breach of law, data breaches and wilful misconduct, which our playbook treats as a critical protection, and narrowed the Licensee indemnity to Licensee-provided content and Licensee's breach of law. As a fallback we can accept the IP indemnity with customary exclusions (Licensee modifications, combinations and specifications) and a super-cap of 3x annual fees.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Article XIII or any other provision of this Agreement, Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Licensed Technology or any deliverable infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (b) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee data caused by Licensor; or (d) Licensor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall control the defense and settlement (provided no settlement imposing liability or admission on the indemnified party shall be made without its consent), and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense.

ops.oldText: (ii) the conduct of Licensee's business directly or through any affiliate of Licensee and/or (iii) the breach by the License of any representation, warranty, obligation, restriction, term and/or covenant under this Agreement.
ops.newText: (ii) content or data provided by Licensee to Licensor and/or (iii) Licensee's breach of applicable law.
